correctness.rationale: For two distinct pure qubit Bloch vectors, C=cos²(θ/2), V=sin²(θ/2)>0 and τ=2η−1, the source contractions give utility (1+Cλ_z+Vλ_x)/2 and fidelity divergence −log(1−Vλ_x²). Every channel has λ_z≤1; |λ_x|≤t makes τ≤C+tV necessary, and I/Z mixing with λ_x=t, λ_z=1 attains it. Group Pauli outcomes into {I,X} and {Y,Z}: q=p_Y+p_Z=(1−λ_x)/2. Entropy chain rule H(Pauli)≥h₂(q)≥h₂((1−t)/2); the two-gate distribution attains equality. This proves feasibility and exact entropy for every θ∈(0,π], t∈[0,1], η∈[0,1], including η and θ boundary cases. At t=1, θ=π, the permitted divergence bound is +infinity; no finite bound is implied. The source optimal contraction a* gives the privacy-optimal specialization. Independent exact 1/10-grid test covers 286 probability vectors and corroborates, but the unrestricted assertion uses the entropy grouping proof.
